    echo \"checking $f\"                                                                                                
                                                                                                                        
    ls -la /tmp/$f || true                                                                                              
  done                                                                                                                  
  systemctl status foo --no-pager                                                                                       
  echo done"                                                                                                            

● SSH to test host and run checks                                                                                       
  ⎿  $ ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=3 nobody@192.0.2.1 "set -e                                                
     cd /tmp                                                                                                            
     for f in a b c; do                                                                                                 
     echo \"checking $f\"                                                                                               
     ls -la /tmp/$f || true                                                                                             
     done                                                                                                               
     systemctl status foo --no-pager                                                                                    
     echo done"
